spans.title: Important note
spans.text: Repeated dynamic `String` concatenation can fragment heap on low-RAM AVR boards such as UNO; fixed buffers and `snprintf` may be better. ESP32 has more RAM, but allocation, lifetime, and bounds risks remain.
